meanings.meaning: The act of one who affirms something; an affirmation.
present participle and gerund of affirm

examples: an affirming smile and approving nod

meanings.meaning: Accepting of same-sex/same-gender sexual relationships – or, more broadly, the gender identities, sexual orientations, and sexual relationships of LGBTQ people – on the same terms as those of cisgender, heterosexual people.
